verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a real search syntax with field qualifiers and negation, e.g. `class:UserError -tag:wip component:"UsersController"`. It supports search by metadata and other attributes, deploy-relative filters such as `occurred.after:'last deploy'`, and BadgerQL for filtering and aggregating event data. A natural-language query builder is also documented. missing for 10: evidence of cross-project search, an explicit environment filter, release/version filtering beyond deploy-relative qualifiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
